Another look-and-feel choice, so I'll just share my preference — both do the same thing, so either is fine with me.

If I'm picking: honestly this one's close. A checkbox does read a little clearer as an on/off toggle — it's obvious it's ticked or not. But it also feels a touch plain, and the button with the label spelled it out just as well. I'll go with the checkbox, since it makes the "is this flagged or not" state easy to read at a glance. Not a strong feeling either way. Let's keep moving.
